description: Move files via a PRIVATE S3 bucket using time-limited pre-signed URLs.
epilog:
How the far end receives it (use with `send` or `link`):
  --to CLIENT     short code via the mediator (recommended)    far end: tx get CODE
  --code [CODE]   short code via the S3 manifest (fallback)    far end: tx get CODE
  (neither)       a plain time-limited URL                     far end: tx get "URL"

Examples:
  s3tx send report.pdf --to laptop       upload + get a code
  s3tx link report.pdf --to laptop       fresh code for a file already in the bucket
  s3tx drop report.pdf --to laptop       receive a file (saved at key 'report.pdf')
  s3tx ls                                list objects
  s3tx codes                             list live codes
  s3tx recv KEY                          download a file
  s3tx rm KEY                            delete one object

Many files, far end → you:   
    (Mac)      s3tx drop bundle.tgz --to laptop
    (far end)  tar czf - f1 dir/ | tx put - CODE
    (Mac)      s3tx recv bundle.tgz             (then: tar xzf bundle.tgz)

Many files, you → far end:
    (Mac)      tar czf - file1 dir/ | s3tx send - bundle.tgz --to laptop
    (far end)  tx get CODE                      (then: tar xzf bundle.tgz)

commands.help: upload a file, print a download link for the far end

commands.help: make a fresh code/link for an object already in the bucket

args.help: scoped single-use code via the mediator for CLIENT
code via the S3 manifest (omit value to auto-generate)

commands.name: drop
commands.help: print an UPLOAD link so the far end can push a file (no creds)

args.help: register a scoped, single-use UPLOAD code via the mediator for CLIENT

commands.name: recv
commands.help: download an object to this machine

commands.name: rmrf
commands.help: delete EVERY object in the bucket (asks for confirmation)

commands.help: show identity, bucket, and confirm the bucket is private

commands.help: force Block-Public-Access ON and remove any bucket policy
